## Job Description
About Flow by ServiceNow
Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We’re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You’ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are.
Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us.
Job Description
We are hiring a Senior Staff Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer to be the most senior technical authority for Flow customers, guiding strategic and enterprise accounts from first demo and trial to long-term, expanding success. You will lead the hardest customer deployments, architect solutions that go beyond what the product does today, and turn what you learn in the field into product strategy. You will also raise the bar for the entire forward deployed team by setting technical standards, building repeatable playbooks, and mentoring other engineers. The role combines deep technical implementation, strategic customer partnership, and cross-functional leadership.
Ready to turn “we’re stuck” into “we’re live” for the most complex enterprise environments? You will own outcomes across multiple strategic customers, influence the Flow roadmap, and define how ServiceNow deploys AI-native products in the field.
What You Will Do
Technical Solutions and Architecture
• Lead technical design and delivery for strategic enterprise deployments, including SSO and identity architecture, multi-system integrations, and security and compliance reviews with customer IT and security leadership.
• Architect and build complex, production-grade automations and workflows with Flow’s natural-language builder across tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow.
• Design knowledge and retrieval strategies across document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base, so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers at enterprise scale.
• Solve problems the product does not yet handle by designing and documenting scalable workarounds, and convert them into reusable patterns, reference architectures, and product capabilities.
• Lead proof-of-concept and strategic evaluation efforts, partnering with sales and executive stakeholders to demonstrate value and win competitive engagements.
Customer Success and Strategic Adoption
• Define and continuously improve the onboarding and implementation motion so new customers set up and enable Flow in a few hours and reach production in one day.
• Act as a trusted advisor to customer IT directors and executives, aligning Flow with their broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow’s plans.
• Use Flow analytics on usage, conversation allowances, and automation results to build business cases, demonstrate value, and drive expansion from an initial use case to a full self-service service desk.
• Own multi-account health and adoption outcomes, identifying risks early and driving executive-level resolution when needed.
Product Influence and Technical Leadership
• Translate patterns across customers into clear product requirements and strategy, and partner with product management and engineering to prioritize and shepherd them through delivery.
• Serve as the voice of the customer in roadmap, architecture, and go-to-market discussions, shaping how Flow is positioned, packaged, and priced.
• Establish technical standards, playbooks, and tooling for the forward deployed function, and scale them across teams.
• Mentor and coach solutions engineers at IC3 and IC4 levels and act as an escalation point for the most difficult issues.
Support and Reliability
• Serve as the final technical escalation for critical customer issues such as API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, and failed automations, and drive them from diagnosis to durable resolution.
• Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them, including systemic issues affecting multiple customers.
• Use Flow health, audit, and activity logs to diagnose complex issues, identify outages, and define monitoring and triage practices that improve reliability for all customers.
## Qualifications
• 10+ years in customer-facing technical roles, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software, including experience leading strategic, multi-system deployments.
• Deep, hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with the ability to design integration architectures and debug them at depth.
• Expert knowledge of single sign-on and identity architectures, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID, and of enterprise security and compliance requirements.
• Extensive experience with enterprise service management or collaboration platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams.
• Strong understanding of AI and workflow automation, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, and evaluating the quality and accuracy of AI answers.
• Proven ability to communicate and influence from system administrators and security engineers to IT directors and executives.
• Demonstrated ability to connect customer outcomes to broader IT and operations strategy and to ServiceNow’s plans.
• Track record of technical leadership and mentorship, and of influencing product direction and cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Preferred
• Experience with service desk offerings.
• Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products.
• Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software.
• Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion, playbooks, or a forward deployed function from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required.

## Job Description
About the role
The Leader of Product Operations builds the operating system that helps Xplor use AI responsibly, adopt it widely, and turn it into revenue and contribution margin, with clear governance and accountability for the results. The role covers three connected areas: AI-enabled productivity, adoption of AI features by our customers, and the commercialization of those features. You will own the shared layer that makes all three work including measurement, value tracking, portfolio governance, intake, cost visibility, and the operating cadence that keeps leaders aligned.
Our products and teams span a wide mix of tools and workflow methodologies. You will create a shared layer of measurement, visibility and improvement that works across them, and that product, engineering, go-to-market and executive leaders all trust, and speeds teams up without creating friction.
You will report to the Chief AI Officer and partner closely with BU presidents, product and R&D leaders, GTM, Finance, Security, Legal, Privacy and the People team. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will build the function and stay close to the data and the teams.
How we work: BUs are central's customers. We measure outcomes, not activity. We decide on a demo, an eval or a metric, not a deck. We keep forums and reporting to the minimum that supports a real decision.
What you'll do
Own the measurement and board scorecard
• Build and run a single scorecard with Finance that records every AI benefit, in one engine, net of AI cost (inference, hosting, tools and support).
• Produce the quarterly AI board scorecard covering value and risk measures, with a named owner and source system for every measure.
• Run a repeatable prioritization and triage process for operations and tooling improvements, with clear owners, expected impact and follow-up on results.
• Turn data into short, decision-ready narratives for the Chief AI Officer and C-suite.
Measure AI-enabled productivity
• Build a measurement framework that links delivery and AI-SDLC productivity signals (cycle time, throughput, quality, adoption of AI tooling) to business outcomes such as idea-to-customer lead time, PR-to-production rate, change failure rate, escaped defects, rework and capacity moved to customer-facing work.
• Help leaders see where AI productivity gains are real, where they are not, and where to invest next.
• Act as a neutral orchestrator across teams that use different tools and methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe-style and hybrids; Jira, Azure DevOps and others), meeting each team where it is.
• Find where gains stall before reaching customers (review wait, regression coverage, late QA, launch readiness) and route the fix.
• Partner with function owners in support, revenue operations, finance and onboarding to baseline target workflows on fully loaded cost per resolved outcome, with quality held constant.
Measure AI product adoption and commercialization
• Own the metrics and standardize reporting for how customers adopt and use AI features across the portfolio at 30-60-90 days, from activation and usage depth to retention and satisfaction.
• Build the commercial view with Finance and BU leaders: AI and data ARR, paid attach, retention and expansion, win-rate uplift, gross margin per AI feature and cost per successful task.
• Run the launch-readiness checklist with BU leaders before any AI price goes live: cost per task known, margin target met after inference, attribution rule and holdout set, sales and customer success enablement ready.
Govern Data and AI accountability
• Operationalize and maintain decision rights, escalation paths and clear ownership for data and AI initiatives, so every investment has a named accountable owner, success measures, and a review date.
• Maintain a portfolio-level register of Data and AI initiatives and risks, and surface issues early to the Chief AI Officer with recommended actions.
• Run the Data and AI vendor and partner inventory and monthly review with Procurement, Finance and Security: spend, overlap, security review, data terms and knowledge transfer from consultants.
• Track adherence to agreed standards and policies, and report exceptions without becoming a bottleneck for teams.
Lead the function
• Hire, develop and lead a product operations team, and set its mandate, operating model and success measures.
• Apply AI to product operations itself, including automated reporting, insight synthesis and workflow automation.
## Qualifications
What you'll bring
Required
• 8+ years in product operations, business operations, strategy and operations, technical program management, product management, or a similar role in a SaaS or technology company, with at least 3 years at a senior or director level.
• A track record of building KPI and measurement frameworks that connect product or delivery data to business outcomes such as adoption, retention and revenue.
• Experience working with Finance, Sales and Marketing on pricing, packaging, launch or go-to-market performance.
• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Customer Success and executive leadership, and influencing without direct authority, including establishing governance, decision rights and accountability mechanisms that teams actually follow.
• Working knowledge of multiple delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and the ability to support teams that use different ones.
• Hands-on fluency with product and delivery tooling (Jira or similar), product analytics, BI and data integration across systems.
• Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting data and tradeoffs clearly to executives.
• Experience building or leading a team, including hiring and coaching.
Preferred
• Experience with product adoption, monetization, or usage-based pricing.
• Experience measuring the impact of AI-assisted development or other engineering productivity programs, including frameworks such as DORA and SPACE.
• Experience in vertical SaaS or a multi-product portfolio, including products at different stages of modernization.
• Comfort using AI tools and automation in your own daily operating workflow.
• Experience with governance, risk classification or responsible-AI programs, working alongside Security, Legal and Privacy.
• Experience managing a vendor and partner portfolio, including consolidation and contract standards.
• Experience with cloud or AI cost management (FinOps): unit economics, cost per task.
Success Measurement
• First 30 Days: Inventory of AI tools, vendors, spend, pilots and production systems complete. Baseline scorecard and product readiness cards published. Steering cadence and decision log running.
• 60 Days: Board scorecard reported on its first full quarter in partnership with FinOps and BU leaders. Cost visibility by BU and product in place. Adoption and cost per task tracked for every live AI pilot. Stage gates in use for new initiatives.
• 90 Days: A

## Job Summary
This role engineers and ships production AI agents into the way a function already works. You embed inside functions across NetApp’s product organization, working inside their environment, systems, and tools. You determine what to build and how, the technical approach and the architecture, by working the problem alongside them rather than from a written specification. You build and ship the system end to end and own that it works and holds up in production - reliable and safe on the function’s real workflows - before rotating to the next function. The role sits within the Agentic Product Management team under the VP, Analytics Growth and AI Native Engineering.
The role combines three skillsets that usually live in three different people: the engineer who architects, writes, and ships the production system; the product-minded builder who can scope the right solution inside an unfamiliar function; and the consultant who can deliver inside a team that is not their own. The engineer is the spine - the person who writes the production code also embeds and scopes inside a function they have never worked in. Building AI agents is the baseline; what you deliver is a working system the host function runs and trusts in production.
A few principles shape how the team approaches its work:
• We start from outcomes, not from tasks. The first question on any engagement is what the process is for and what good looks like, not how to automate the current steps.
• We deliver working solutions, not recommendations. Every engagement ends with a prototype that real users can run.
• We design with audit trails. Every workflow is inspectable: which agent did what, against what input, with what reasoning.
• We expand trust deliberately. Agents start with bounded authority, and authority grows as evidence accumulates.
## Key Responsibilities
• Embed inside a host function. Drop into a Product Group function such as product operations, program management, UX design, or product management - one that is not your own - for the duration of the engagement, and build the relationship with its leader and the operators who do the work today.
• Scope the technical solution. Working from the problem the host team surfaces, decide what to build and how - the approach, the architecture, where an agent removes real toil, and where human judgment, relationships, or accountability must stay in the loop.
• Build and ship the agent end to end. Put a working system into the host team’s live workflow using their real systems and data - prompts, tools, retrieval, sub-agents, and the integration code the deployment requires. The deliverable is production code running in the host team’s live workflow.
• Make quality measurable. Build for non-deterministic systems: evaluations, golden sets, and regression checks that make the agent’s quality defensible before it touches real work. You can show the system is correct from the evidence.
• Own that it works in production. Success is a system the host team runs and trusts on live work. You are accountable for the agent being correct and dependable under production conditions, and you run the engagement to that bar.
• Deliver like a consulting engagement. Scope the work, set expectations with host-team leadership, deliver on a timeline, and hand off with enablement so the team can operate the system after you leave.
• Rotate across teams and domains. Each engagement is time-boxed. You move across multiple host teams over the year, applying the same discipline to a new problem each time.
• Partner with security, IT, and data owners. In each host environment, work with the relevant owners to land agents responsibly under NetApp standards for access, privacy, and acceptable use, and to get the workflow approved.
• Contribute patterns back. Capture reusable components from each engagement - agent designs, prompt patterns, evaluation harnesses, integration approaches - and add them to the team’s shared infrastructure so later deployments move faster. Feed what you learn in the field back to the platform and roadmap, including missing capabilities and what should become paved-road infrastructure.
## Education and Experience
• Typically requires 8+ years shipping production software, with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Hands-on fluency with current AI tooling, including LLMs, prompt and context engineering, tool and function calling, retrieval, agent frameworks, evaluation for non-deterministic systems, and protocols such as Model Context Protocol. Familiarity with Cursor and Claude Code is preferred, and experience with LangGraph and/or LangSmith is highly preferred; experience with other orchestration platforms and agent frameworks is welcome
• Strong problem discovery, structured thinking, and stakeholder management skills, including navigating security, IT, and data-owner review without losing the intent of the original design.
• Comfort operating in high ambiguity, including when the problem as described does not match the data and systems on the ground, and a preference for moving between engagements over owning one long-lived codebase. Breadth applied fast matters more here than deep specialization in one stack.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical limits to non-technical stakeholders, disagree productively, and adjust as evidence evolves.
Compensation:

The salary offered will be determined by the candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and education and may be outside of this range. Final compensation packages are competitive and in line with industry standards, reflecting a variety of factors, and include a comprehensive benefits package. This may cover Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Retirement or Pension Plans, Paid Time Off, various Leave options, Performance-Based Incentives, employee stock purchase plan, and/or restricted stocks (RSU’s), with all offerings subject to regional variations and governed by local laws, regulations, and company policies. ## Job Description
Join Azenta Life Sciences , a global leader driving innovation in life sciences, where fresh ideas, collaboration, and authenticity power groundbreaking discoveries. Be part of a diverse, people-first culture managing over 1 billion samples worldwide and accelerating breakthroughs to market.
Our Global Service Team is looking for an Customer Support Engineer at our customer site in Frederick , Maryland .
How you’ll add value in the role of Field Service Engineer …
The Field Service Engineer performs basic/routine customer support activities involving the installation, modification, repair and preventive maintenance of Azenta's equipment and systems generally at customer sites, to ensure proper working order. Works under supervision following established policies and procedures to ensure company and customer quality standards are met. Discretion and independent judgment are required resolving customer issues. Candidate will be assigned to support a specific customer site, region, or product, depending upon business needs.
What you’ll do…
• Install, modify, repair, conduct preventive diagnosis, and perform maintenance on the software and hardware of the equipment and systems while adhering to Azenta's policies, procedures and work direction of supervisor or shift/site lead.
• Interface with customers to ensure contract SLA & customer satisfaction levels are maintained with terms of the service agreement/provision
• Maintain a safe and clean working environment by conforming at all times to Azenta's and customer’s work protocols and policies.
• Attain Equipment Service and Operation Certification on equipment and systems as defined
• Submit reports, such as Service and Status Reports, on all support activities as defined and required.
• Productively react to changing priorities such as Tool or Line down and escalations and support organizational and administrative duties.
• Adopt PoC for both customer and internal Azenta Management.
• Provide weekly system performance summaries that reports number of system events (weekly, monthly, and rolling), issue pareto analysis, and root cause / corrective actions.
• Additional KPI measurement requests throughout the contract period will be considered.
• Assist with sample migration (initial transfer from old format to new format and load into customer Store)
What you’ll bring…
• Associate of Science (AS) degree, technical certificate or equivalent experience is required.
• A minimum of 5 years related work experience or military technical training is required.
• Strong Electrical & Mechanical background.
• Must possess excellent communication skills with the ability to read, write and speak with clarity in the English language and interface effectively with customers and peers.
• Requires excellent systematic troubleshooting skills utilizing a structured and comprehensive process to determine the root cause of an outage, with the ability to handle problems independently and implement corrective action.
• Displays commitment to resolve problems and make independent decisions based upon the priority of the problem in relation to business needs.
• Must have a valid driver’s license, good driving record, reliable mode of transportation and able to obtain a valid passport for the term of employment.
• Must be qualified to meet the requirements of background screening by a third-party agency.
• Must be proficient with use of a PC, Windows, and DOS based Operating Systems. Oracle experience highly beneficial. Be able to use the company’s standard software to generate reports, presentations and document the daily activities as defined and expected by your manager.
• Preferably you live in the area Maryland, United States (Frederick area) .
Working conditions
• International travel is required at times.
• On rare occasions, individuals may be asked to be on-call, or work on holidays, or weekends.
• Work in cold environments
• Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds, climb ladders, scaffoldings, and use Personal Protective Equipment.

• Compliance & Standards: You’ll ensure all web experiences meet brand, SEO, legal, regulatory, and ADA compliance requirements.
• Technology Integration: You’ll support integration of marketing technologies and tools into web platforms.
• Analytics-Driven Improvements: You’ll leverage data insights to refine and optimize digital solutions.
• Documentation & Process: You’ll document workflows, technical requirements, and implementation processes.
• Ownership & Execution: You’ll independently manage assigned work, taking projects from initial direction through successful completion with strong accountability.
This isn’t just about ticking off tasks on a list. It's about making a significant, positive change in BECU’s journey, where your contributions are valued, and your growth is continually fostered.
WHAT YOU’LL GAIN:
• High-Impact Work: You’ll directly influence member-facing digital experiences that drive growth and engagement.
• Modern Tech Exposure: You’ll gain hands-on experience with a Digital Experience Platform transformation (Sitecore → Optimizely).
• Ownership & Autonomy: You’ll have the opportunity to take full ownership of projects and see your work through end-to-end.

• 1 year of experience in web development, digital solutions, or digital marketing technology roles.

• Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (jQuery or modern frameworks preferred).
• Experience working with CMS platforms, specifically Optimizely.
• Familiarity with front-end frameworks such as Bootstrap or equivalent.
• Experience building and supporting digital campaigns and website enhancements.
• Understanding of digital testing and optimization methodologies.

• Exposure to personalization tools or marketing automation platforms is a plus.

## Meet the Team
Our team is part of the Cisco AI and Automation portfolio, responsible for the "Circuit" platform—the central AI engine that powers productivity and process automation for all of Cisco. We are a rapidly expanding, high-impact group dedicated to building the vehicle for AI-driven business transformation. We operate at the intersection of applied research and production, ensuring our technology is not only cutting-edge but also optimized for performance, reliability, and functional quality for our 80,000+ monthly users.
As an Automation QA Engineer, you are the guardian of that functional quality—owning the automated testing ecosystem that keeps Circuit reliable, scalable, and production-ready across every release. This is a hybrid position.
## Your Impact
As an Automation QA Engineer , you will drive the transformation of our regression testing ecosystem, moving beyond manual processes to build AI-driven, fully automated test suites for both new and legacy features. You will design and own end-to-end (E2E), API, and performance test automation that ensures the Circuit platform continues to meet Cisco's high standards for functional quality and performance.
You will build and maintain scalable test frameworks, integrate them into CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality feedback, and leverage AI-assisted coding tools (such as Cursor, Copilot, or Claude Code) to generate and maintain tests—while rigorously validating that AI-generated artifacts are stable, correct, and compliant with security standards. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to automate functional quality and reduce technical debt directly ensures Circuit remains a reliable vehicle for process automation across Cisco.
## Responsibilities
Automated Regression & E2E Testing: Architect, build, and maintain comprehensive automated regression and end-to-end test suites for the entire Circuit platform using Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript), Python/Pytest , and Selenium, replacing manual QA with scalable automation.
API Testing: Design and automate REST and GraphQL API test suites covering functional correctness, contract validation, error handling, and performance—including validation of AI/model-serving endpoints under concurrent load.
Performance & Load Testing: Plan and execute load, stress, and soak tests using k6 or JMeter, ; track response-time percentiles (p95/p99), throughput, error rates, and AI-specific metrics such as Time to First Token (TTFT) and inter-token latency.
AI-Driven Test Automation: Use AI agents and AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) to generate and maintain regression suites for new and legacy features; read and judge the stability of auto-generated code and ensure it does not violate security standards before it is merged.
AI Application & Agent Validation: Develop testing approaches for AI/LLM features—validating model response quality, behavior consistency (stability testing), and end-to-end AI agent workflows across both the reasoning and action layers.
CI/CD Integration & Reporting: Integrate all automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent) for continuous validation; build dashboards and reports (Grafana, Allure) and communicate quality metrics, risk assessments, and defect trends to engineering leadership.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as a "Team Captain" for automation initiatives—defining standards, mentoring peers, and collaborating with development, product, and UX teams to embed automation-first testing into the core development lifecycle.
## Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree with 4+ years, Master's degree with 3+ years, or PhD with 1+ year of related experience in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related technical field.
• Experience in test automation and regression framework development , with a deep understanding of functional quality assurance.
• Experience with Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) for E2E/UI automation and/or Python with Pytest /Robot Framework; familiarity with Selenium.
• Experience with REST API testing (and familiarity with API contract testing); GraphQL testing a plus.
• Solid conceptual and practical knowledge of software development lifecycles, including CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar) and automated testing best practices.
• Experience in AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code), critical thinking, and Agile/Git workflows to ensure high-quality, scalable test automation
## Preferred Qualifications
• Experience testing AI/ML-powered web applications , including LLM-based features, chatbots, or AI agent workflows.
• Hands-on experience with performance/load testing (k6, JMeter) and AI/LLM performance metrics (TTFT, inter-token latency, token throughput).
• Experience in AI Ops / MLOps , or building/fine-tuning custom LLMs.
• Experience with observability and reporting tools such as Splunk , Grafana, Prometheus,
• Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes for test environment management, and with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Proven track record of leading technical projects and mentoring junior engineers.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.
• Experience building and productizing agentic applications with a focus on evaluation and business acceptance.

The Solution Engineer - Data Governance is responsible for the day-to-day operation, configuration, and integration of the data governance and data security platforms owned by the Data Governance department. These include Microsoft Purview (Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, Insider Risk Management, Data Map, and Unified Catalog), network DLP, user and entity behavior analytics, data security posture management, and the governance capabilities of Databricks Unity Catalog.
This role keeps these tools connected, healthy, and producing reliable results. It onboards new data sources and tools securely and with least privilege, and pulls data from these tools to produce the metrics, reports, and audit evidence that leadership and auditors rely on. Scripting is used to close gaps where native tool capability falls short; it supports the role but is not the main focus. The position works closely with the Data Governance analysts, Cybersecurity Engineering, IT Operations, Data Engineering, and vendors.
Essential Job Functions
• Administer and configure data governance and data security tools to approved standards, including sensitivity labels, DLP and insider risk policies, classification scans, and catalog settings, following change management.
• Onboard data sources to scanning and classification tools, including registering sources, configuring service principals, managed identities, integration runtimes, private connectivity, and secrets, and setting scan scope, schedules, and exclusions.
• Monitor tool health, including scan completion, connector status, policy deployment, and alert flow; troubleshoot and resolve failures, and manage vendor support cases through to resolution.
• Lead the technical review of new tool integrations and vendor deployments. Before change approval, document every account, permission, network change, and data flow the tool requires and validate least privilege. After deployment, verify the environment matches what was approved.
• Integrate governance and security tools with each other and with surrounding platforms (Entra ID, Azure, Databricks, Microsoft 365, SIEM, ITSM), using native connectors first and APIs where needed.
• Support tool evaluations and proofs of concept by turning use cases into test plans and success criteria, standing up test configurations, and documenting results.
• Extract data from tool consoles, audit logs, and APIs to produce recurring metrics such as classification coverage, DLP activity, insider risk alert volume and triage time, and catalog coverage; automate recurring reports and Power BI dashboards.
• Produce configuration and operating evidence for internal audit, regulatory, and client requests.
• Write and maintain scripts (PowerShell, Python, SQL, KQL) to close gaps in native tool functionality and automate repetitive administration.
• Maintain as-built documentation, configuration baselines, SOPs, and runbooks for each tool.
• Work with DLP, insider risk, and stewardship analysts to implement the policy and tuning changes they define.
• Track vendor product changes and roadmaps and assess their impact on current configurations.

• Experience in a healthcare or Revenue Cycle Management setting is a plus.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Data Engineer III , a data engineer or analytics engineer who wants to work directly with the business, to join EverHealth’s revenue cycle management (RCM) team. RCM is at the heart of how our customers get paid, and we are building a new generation of RCM tools that pair modern workflow software with AI agents to help billing teams work smarter, resolve issues faster, and collect more of what they’ve earned. This work is part of our broader focus on finding where automation, AI, and new experiences can make the biggest impact across the EverHealth portfolio.

Your job is to make sure the people accountable for results have the data and insights they need. Today, many RCM workflows and outcomes are hard to see. Job Location – Remote within the US; Must be able to support EST hours
What You Will Do

• Design, develop, and maintain reusable automated functional, integration, and regression tests for application workflows and supporting services, including APIs where applicable.
• Design strategy for switching roles in pipelined automated test jobs and provide guidance for application/ops teams toward support of those patterns.

• Experience writing Gherkin feature files and reusable step definitions with Cucumber or a comparable BDD framework. Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and managing test code through version control and peer review.
• Experience deriving functional, integration, and regression tests from requirements and acceptance criteria, documenting defects, and verifying fixes within an Agile delivery team.
• Experience validating data-driven application behavior and using test evidence to identify quality issues and assess release readiness.

• Experience establishing test architecture for a new or modernized application.

Certent Equity Management is used by corporate stock plan administrators, brokers, transfer agents, auditors, and teams across tax, accounting, treasury, finance, payroll, legal, and HR to manage and report on equity compensation.

• Provide data analysis, report writing, file management, database auditing, and technical support on equity plan data

• Respond to direct customer inquiries during peak periods such as vesting events, ESPP purchase dates, and quarter and year-end reporting
• Document knowledge base solutions for internal and external use
• Maintain broker-facing documentation, including integration specifications, file layouts, and support procedures

Owns the quality engineering function for an agentic conversational AI platform — serving as the guardian of the customer experience across every voice and chat interaction. This role spans two mandates: hands-on assurance that every release is effective and defect-free before it reaches end users, and building, scaling, and maintaining the evaluation infrastructure that makes quality continuous, measurable, and increasingly self-improving.
The role plans and directs the development, application, and maintenance of quality standards for conversational AI applications and their supporting systems and owns the automated evaluation platform — synthetic and adversarial agent-to-agent conversation testing, DeepEval test suites, proprietary LLM-as-judge evaluators, and deterministic rule-based checks — as the system of record for shipping model, prompt, and agent changes with confidence. Because LLM systems are non-deterministic, this role designs test plans and evaluation rubrics that turn ambiguous notions of quality into clear, defensible metrics, and correlates those metrics with real-world performance and user experience.
The role is weighted toward quality infrastructure and evaluation engineering (~70%), balanced with hands-on manual and exploratory QA (~30%), with an explicit mandate to advance the platform toward recursive self-improvement: a closed-loop quality flywheel in which evaluation findings automatically generate new test cases, refine judge rubrics, surface model and prompt improvement candidates, and re-validate fixes — so the evaluators, and the agents they evaluate, get better with every conversation.
